name: Cernos Gel 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About CERNOS GEL

CERNOS GEL contains Testosterone which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgens. It is used in adult men to replace testosterone in male hypogonadism (various health problems caused by a deficiency of testosterone). Male hypogonadism is characterized by symptoms like impotence, infertility, decreased sex drive, tiredness, depressive moods and bone loss due to low hormone levels.

CERNOS GEL is not recommended for use if you have known or suspected prostate or breast cancer. Consult your doctor before using it.

CERNOS GEL should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure, chronic lung diseases, severe liver, kidney or heart disease, diabetes, urinary problems due to enlarged prostate. Consult your doctor before using it.

CERNOS GEL is intended for use by men only. It is not indicated for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

CERNOS GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before using it.

The most common side effects of using CERNOS GEL are burning or prickling sensation, dryness, rash, redness or itchiness at the site of application. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: To replace testosterone in male hypogonadism in adult men

How CERNOS GEL Works

CERNOS GEL works by replacing testosterone in adult male patients with hypogonadism (various health problems caused by a lack of testosterone, a natural male hormone). Thus, helps to improve clinical symptoms such as impotence, infertility, low sex drive, tiredness, depressive moods, bone loss caused by low hormone levels.
usageDetails:
How to use CERNOS GEL

Always apply CERNOS GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply to clean, dry, intact skin of the shoulders and/or upper arms. Application should be limited to the area that will be covered by your short sleeve T-shirt. Cover the application sites with clothing (Ex. a t-shirt) after the medicine has dried.

Wash your hands properly with soap and water after application. Do not apply this medicine to the genitals. Avoid showering or washing the administration site for a minimum of 2 hours after application.

name: Testoviron Depot 250 Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About TESTOVIRON DEPOT 250 INJECTION

Testoviron Depot 250 Injection is a testosterone replacement therapy used for managing male hypogonadism and low testosterone levels and associated signs like delayed puberty in boys, impotence, low bone mineral density, fatigue, feeling low or depression and low muscle mass in men who have underlying medical conditions.

It contains an active ingredient called testosterone enanthate, a synthetic form of testosterone (male sex hormone), designed to manage low testosterone levels in men. It helps restore normal hormonal balance, improving symptoms like fatigue, low libido, and loss of muscle mass. Administered via intramuscular injection skin under a doctor's supervision, it provides long-lasting effects.

Your doctor will determine the correct dosage based on your condition. Always inform your doctor about any pre-existing conditions and other medications you are taking. Regular blood tests are recommended to monitor testosterone and PSA levels.

Common side effects of testoviron injection include swelling, rapid weight gain, coughing, and injection site reactions like pain or redness. Serious side effects may require discontinuation of the medication, such as breathing difficulties or persistent erections.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TESTOVIRON DEPOT 250 INJECTION
Low Testosterone levels
Male hypogonadism

Post marketing experience of FDA suggest that Testosterone products are FDA-approved only for use in men who lack or have low testosterone levels in conjunction with an associated medical condition such as failure of the testicles to produce testosterone due to genetic problems or chemotherapy, or problems with brain structures (pituitary related hormonal imbalance).

Benefits of Testoviron Injection for men:

1. Boosts Testosterone Levels Naturally

Testoviron Depot 250 provides a reliable source of testosterone for men with hypogonadism (low testosterone levels), helping restore hormonal balance effectively. By addressing testosterone deficiency, testosterone helps improve sexual health, including impotence, libido and erectile function.

2. Improves Muscle Strength and Mass

Clinical studies have shown that testosterone injection is known to enhance protein synthesis in the body, promoting muscle growth and improving overall strength, making it beneficial for fitness enthusiasts and athletes with medical needs.

3. Supports Bone Health:

Testosterone plays a key role in maintaining bone density. This injection helps reduce the risk of osteoporosis and strengthens bones over time.

4. Boosts Energy Levels and Mood

Studies have shown that low testosterone levels are often associated with fatigue and depression. Testoviron Depot 250 injection can elevate mood, enhance energy levels, and reduce symptoms of lethargy.

5. Improves Red Blood Cell Production

Testosterone stimulates red blood cell production, which may help combat anemia and improve oxygen supply throughout the body.

The dosage and frequency are determined by your doctor based on your condition and hormone levels.

How to use TESTOVIRON DEPOT 250 INJECTION

Testoviron Depot Injection will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse in hospital or clinics.

How to Use Testoviron Injection:
Testoviron Depot 250 Injection is designed for intramuscular administration (into the muscles) and should only be given by a trained healthcare professional.
The dosage and frequency are determined by your doctor based on your condition and hormone levels.
Typically, it is administered every 2-3 weeks. The injections are continued for as long as your doctor considers necessary, depending on your individual health needs.
Men receiving long term therapy may later be given injections at 3-to-6-week intervals.
Never attempt to self-administer this injection, as improper administration can lead to complications.
Testoviron Dosage for Low Testosterone:

The dosage for managing low testosterone with Testoviron Depot 250 Injection generally ranges from 250 mg every 2-4 weeks, depending on the severity of testosterone deficiency and your doctor’s recommendation. Regular monitoring of testosterone levels is essential to adjust the dosage for optimal results.

Testoviron Dosage for Bodybuilding:

For bodybuilding purposes, testosterone injections are sometimes misused to enhance muscle growth and strength. However, such usage is off-label and not medically recommended. Misuse of testosterone injections can lead to serious side effects like hormonal imbalance, liver damage, and cardiovascular risks. Therefore, proper health consultation and careful monitoring of testosterone levels are required.

Testoviron Dosage for Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT)

In Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT), the typical dose of Testoviron Depot 250 is 100-250 mg administered every 2-4 weeks. Your doctor may adjust the dosage based on your blood testosterone levels and symptoms. This therapy helps restore hormonal balance in men with hypogonadism.

Testoviron Depot 250 Injection Cycle Duration:

The typical cycle duration for Testoviron Depot 250 depends on the medical condition being treated. For testosterone replacement therapy, cycles may last several months to years under a doctor's supervision.

What Happens if I Overdose on Testoviron Injection?

Overdosing on Testoviron Depot 250 can lead to serious side effects such as severe hormonal imbalance, liver damage, acne, mood swings, and water retention. Prolonged overdosing may increase the risk of cardiovascular problems or gynecomastia (breast tissue enlargement in men). If you suspect an overdose, seek immediate medical attention to prevent complications.

Testoviron Depot 100 Injection is a testosterone replacement therapy used for managing male hypogonadism and low testosterone levels and associated signs like delayed puberty in boys, impotence, low bone mineral density, fatigue, feeling low or depression and low muscle mass in men who have underlying medical conditions.

It contains an active ingredient called testosterone enanthate, a synthetic form of testosterone (male sex hormone), designed to manage low testosterone levels in men. It helps restore normal hormonal balance, improving symptoms like fatigue, low libido, and loss of muscle mass. Administered via intramuscular injection skin under a doctor's supervision, it provides long-lasting effects.

Your doctor will determine the correct dosage based on your condition. Always inform your doctor about any pre-existing conditions and other medications you are taking. Regular blood tests are recommended to monitor testosterone and PSA levels.

Common side effects of testoviron injection include swelling, rapid weight gain, coughing, and injection site reactions like pain or redness. Serious side effects may require discontinuation of the medication, such as breathing difficulties or persistent erections.

Clinical studies have shown that testosterone injection is known to enhance protein synthesis in the body, promoting muscle growth and improving overall strength, making it beneficial for fitness enthusiasts and athletes with medical needs.

Testosterone plays a key role in maintaining bone density. This injection helps reduce the risk of osteoporosis and strengthens bones over time.

Studies have shown that low testosterone levels are often associated with fatigue and depression. Testoviron Depot 100 injection can elevate mood, enhance energy levels, and reduce symptoms of lethargy.

Testosterone stimulates red blood cell production, which may help combat anemia and improve oxygen supply throughout the body.

Introduction About GONABLOK 50MG CAPSULE

GONABLOK 50MG CAPSULE contains Danazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgens. It is used to manage endometriosis, severe cyclical mastalgia (breast pain associated with hormonal variations), breast cysts, dysfunctional uterine bleeding (bleeding from vagina other than that of menstrual cycle), symptomatic gynecomastia, preoperative thinning of endometrium and hereditary angioneurotic edema (painless swelling under the skin).

Endometriosis is defined as an illness where some of the tissues that line the womb are found elsewhere in the body. Gynecomastia refers to an increase in the amount of breast gland tissue in males, due to an imbalance of hormones estrogen and testosterone.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with GONABLOK 50MG CAPSULE, as it may cause nausea or breathlessness.

Before taking GONABLOK 50MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have hormonal cancer, blood clots, heart, liver or kidney problems or porphyria.

GONABLOK 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

Safety and effectiveness of GONABLOK 50MG CAPSULE in paediatric and elderly patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking GONABLOK 50MG CAPSULE are weight gain, bloating, nausea, vomiting, lethargy and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with ZENDOL 200MG CAPSULE, as it may cause nausea or breathlessness.

Before taking ZENDOL 200MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have hormonal cancer, blood clots, heart, liver or kidney problems or porphyria.

ZENDOL 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

Safety and effectiveness of ZENDOL 200MG CAPSULE in paediatric and elderly patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking ZENDOL 200MG CAPSULE are weight gain, bloating, nausea, vomiting, lethargy and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

DANOGEN 200MG CAPSULE works by suppressing the secretion of gonadotropins (a group hormones that stimulate the activity of the gonads) in both men and women, leading to inhibition of testicular/ovarian function. In addition, it suppresses gonadal function directly by inhibiting the enzymes involved in steroid hormone synthesis.

Do not stop taking DANOGEN 200MG CAPSULE unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About GONABLOK 200MG CAPSULE

GONABLOK 200MG CAPSULE contains Danazol which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgens. It is used to manage endometriosis, severe cyclical mastalgia (breast pain associated with hormonal variations), breast cysts, dysfunctional uterine bleeding (bleeding from vagina other than that of menstrual cycle), symptomatic gynecomastia, preoperative thinning of endometrium and hereditary angioneurotic edema (painless swelling under the skin).

Endometriosis is defined as an illness where some of the tissues that line the womb are found elsewhere in the body. Gynecomastia refers to an increase in the amount of breast gland tissue in males, due to an imbalance of hormones estrogen and testosterone.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with GONABLOK 200MG CAPSULE, as it may cause nausea or breathlessness.

Before taking GONABLOK 200MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have hormonal cancer, blood clots, heart, liver or kidney problems or porphyria.

GONABLOK 200MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women, therefore consult your doctor before taking it.

Safety and effectiveness of GONABLOK 200MG CAPSULE in paediatric and elderly patients have not been established.

The most common side effects of taking GONABLOK 200MG CAPSULE are weight gain, bloating, nausea, vomiting, lethargy and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About PROFICENT 10000IU INJECTION

PROFICENT 10000IU INJECTION contains Chorionic gonadotropin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It is used to manage hypogonadism (deficiency of sex hormones) in men. It also helps in the release of matured ovum (eggs) from the ovaries (ovulation) among infertile women after undergoing premanagement with suitable hormonal medicines (such as menotropins or FSH).

It also helps in sustaining pregnancy during the early stages among women who experience habitual abortions. It can also be used in the management of prepubertal cryptorchidism (failure of testis to descend into the scrotum) caused by hormone deficiency in young male children (aged between 4 and 9 years).

During management with PROFICENT 10000IU INJECTION, your doctor would monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects like fluid accumulation, abnormally enlarged ovarian follicles, or multiple pregnancies (pregnant with more than one child), especially if you are undergoing assisted reproductive techniques.

Before receiving PROFICENT 10000IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any forms of cancer in the ovaries, uterus, breasts, or prostate. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with PROFICENT 10000IU INJECTION may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

PROFICENT 10000IU INJECTION may cause a false positive pregnancy result in women who take a pregnancy test using their blood or urine. This effect may last up to 10 days even after discontinuing management with PROFICENT 10000IU INJECTION.

PROFICENT 10000IU INJECTION may be used to sustain pregnancy during the initial stages (luteal phase). However, it should not be used in the later stages of pregnancy. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of PROFICENT 10000IU INJECTION are reaching puberty at an early age, pain at the injection site, headaches, and irritability. Consult your doctor if they worsen.

Introduction About KORAGON HP 5000IU INJECTION

KORAGON HP 5000IU INJECTION contains Chorionic gonadotropin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It is used to manage hypogonadism (deficiency of sex hormones) in men. It also helps in the release of matured ovum (eggs) from the ovaries (ovulation) among infertile women after undergoing premanagement with suitable hormonal medicines (such as menotropins or FSH).

It also helps in sustaining pregnancy during the early stages among women who experience habitual abortions. It can also be used in the management of prepubertal cryptorchidism (failure of testis to descend into the scrotum) caused by hormone deficiency in young male children (aged between 4 and 9 years).

During management with KORAGON HP 5000IU INJECTION, your doctor would monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects like fluid accumulation, abnormally enlarged ovarian follicles, or multiple pregnancies (pregnant with more than one child), especially if you are undergoing assisted reproductive techniques.

Before receiving KORAGON HP 5000IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any forms of cancer in the ovaries, uterus, breasts, or prostate. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with KORAGON HP 5000IU INJECTION may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

KORAGON HP 5000IU INJECTION may cause a false positive pregnancy result in women who take a pregnancy test using their blood or urine. This effect may last up to 10 days even after discontinuing management with KORAGON HP 5000IU INJECTION.

KORAGON HP 5000IU INJECTION may be used to sustain pregnancy during the initial stages (luteal phase). However, it should not be used in the later stages of pregnancy. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of KORAGON HP 5000IU INJECTION are reaching puberty at an early age, pain at the injection site, headaches, and irritability. Consult your doctor if they worsen.
